title: Alto Neuroscience Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights
summary: – Phase 2b clinical trial of ALTO-207 in treatment-resistant depression (TRD) initiated – – New ALTO-101 analyses support significant effects on EEG markers of general cognition as well as a test of attention – – Closed $120 million PIPE in March 2026; cash balance of approximately $264 million expected to fund planned operations through 2029, including a potential NDA submission for ALTO-207 – Alto Neuroscience, Inc.
